Numeric LAMBDA, with free and state-dependent cells taken as 1.

Source: R/ctDataStart.R
dot-ctDataStartLambda.Rd

Only used to divide an indicator's spread back to its process, so a loading that is not yet a number is better treated as unity than dropped.

Usage

.ctDataStartLambda(spec, nmanifest, nlatent)
